description: This file defines the EmployeeMembership entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing employee membership details with ORM mappings, properties, and accessor methods.

classes.name: EmployeeMembership
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's membership details, mapped to 'hs_hr_emp_member_detail' database table, with properties for employee, membership, fees, and dates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the EmployeeMembership record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the EmployeeMembership record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this membership.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this membership.

methods.name: getMembership
methods.description: Returns the Membership object linked to this employee.

methods.name: setMembership
methods.description: Links a Membership object to this employee's membership record.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Returns who paid the subscription fee.

methods.name: setSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Specifies who paid the subscription fee.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency used for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the renewal date for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Sets the renewal date for the subscription.
